Clock strictness, refining the last clock steer. Jack Heart: "i do think we should have some amount of config between: - no non-init-declared clocks vs not - all clocks set every update vs not", then, on sparse rows for occasional evals: "Right be we have a separate eval paradigm". So: (1) track(clocks=["updates", ...]) is optional; given, the set is closed and any other clock keyword is refused (typo safety); omitted, clocks are declared by use. (2) every row carries every clock in use; no sparse switch (evals are their own runs; add one only when a real case needs it). strict= keeps deciding raise vs warn-once. Words in scratch/demo-hanabi.md.
